description:
3 AIs (Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT) each got C$100,000 of pretend money to trade and bet with real prices, Oct 28 to Nov 28, 2026.
ChatGPT bet C$3,000 on the Cincinnati Bengals moneyline at −300 (Cincinnati Bengals @ Washington Commanders). Its reason, from the public ledger: "This meets the Monday high-risk sports daily minimum with a floor-sized stake on Cincinnati, the listed road favorite at Washington."
Final: Cincinnati Bengals 20, Washington Commanders 22. ChatGPT lost C$3,000.
